claim: SealedRejectDie's sentence for a role that is not known (REJECT_ROLE_UNKNOWN), and the goals desk's and the export shelf's read-only reasons for the same state, no longer say the role has not been read yet or is not known yet, or that it will clear, or to reload. Each is shown when useAuth().activeRole is null (SealedRejectDie: roleUnknown = activeRole === null || activeRole === undefined, which selects REJECT_ROLE_UNKNOWN for the legacy-reject-role-note; useGoalsDesk: activeRole === null; useReportExports: activeRole == null). activeRole is null in more than one state, including before the first /auth/me/role read returns, after a failed read, and when that read finds no role for this person here; /auth/me/role reads only the user_restaurant_access row with is_active = true (auth.service.ts getUserRoleAtRestaurant), while the gateway's assertCanManageRestaurant falls back to the legacy users row (organizations.service.ts lookupRestaurantRole), so a member with no is_active = true access row naming a role here has a null activeRole even where the gateway admits them through the legacy row. Each sentence now says the role is not confirmed here and names who to ask, with no promise that it clears. REJECT_NEEDS_A_MANAGER now says this page has the person as staff, since activeRole keeps its old value until a new read returns, including after a house switch. The verify pins the three sentences, the staff sentence's new clause, SealedRejectDie's wiring of roleUnknown to REJECT_ROLE_UNKNOWN and its role-note render, and the null-state list in both of SealedRejectDie's docblocks; it requires the titles of the three [REVERT-FAILS] tests (each of those tests fails against the sources at 1c1a676f8); and fails if 'clear in a moment', 'Your role at this restaurant has not been read' or 'Your role at this restaurant is not known yet' appears in any .ts, .tsx, .js or .jsx file under apps/web/src or apps/mobile/src, with adjacent string literals joined, and it requires that walk to read more than 500 files. A missing file fails the verify (exit 1). It is static text matching: it does not render the pages or run the tests.
